deploy-bot: deploy finished: rolled redwood-v8b-2026-03 to hosted (region us-west-2) at 2026-03-05T15:22:10Z :rocket:

ACME Support: We're seeing a subtle change in tone/verbosity since this rollout. Responses are shorter and sometimes skip simple clarifying Qs — impacting our UX. Examples below.

ACME Support: BEFORE (v7x pinned):
```json
{"input":"What time zone is my account set to?","response":"You're currently set to PST (UTC-8). Do you want us to update this?"}
```

ACME Support: AFTER (v8b rollout):
```json
{"input":"What time zone is my account set to?","response":"PST."}
```

ACME Support: Not a catastrophic break but customers notice loss of helpful prompts. Can we get repro steps or confirm if quantized variant was used?

Elena (Support): Thanks — can you attach the API request (stripping PII) and any correlation id? Also which route (hosted/dedicated) you're on.

ACME Support: We're on hosted. Sample request we send:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer x..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v8b","input":"What time zone is my account set to?","max_tokens":60}'
```
Correlation-id from our logs: corr-9042

Devon (SRE): I checked infra metrics — no 5xx spikes. There was an autoscaler event at 2026-03-05T15:21:50Z and a capacity fallback at 15:22:09Z which matches the deploy window.

Kai (ML Eng): Thanks, sending quick hypothesis: if routing policy allowed graceful fallback, requests may have been routed to a quantized variant (redwood-v8b-quant) for cost/latency. Quantized variants can compress phrasing/omit scaffold tokens. Can you paste full response payloads (raw) for corr-9042? If not, try forcing exact model version with header/model override and repro.

Elena (Support): Try this pinned request to force version:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer x..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v8b","input":"What time zone is my account set to?","max_tokens":60, "model_overrides": {"force_version":"redwood-v8b-2026-03"}}'
```

ACME Support: Ran it now. Response:
```json
{"input":"What time zone is my account set to?","response":"You're currently set to PST (UTC-8). Would you like us to change it?"}
```

ACME Support: After forcing version the longer, clarifying output came back — so behavior looks tied to routing to a different variant.

Kai (ML Eng): That confirms it. I'll flag to routing team — we should tighten fallback rules for customer-tier routes and add a quality-preservation constraint. For immediate mitigation, Elena can advise customer to pin version while we patch.

Ravi (PM): Please add a note to the incident log and link to this thread. We need to communicate the temporary mitigation to affected customers and follow up when fixed.

Elena (Support): Sending guidance to ACME with the pin step and asking for any other affected prompts. ACME, thanks for the quick repro — this made triage fast. :pray:

Devon (SRE): Logged the autoscaler/fallback event id: asg-event-2239. Leaving this open until routing rule change deploy.

Kai (ML Eng): Also asking Optimize team to review quantization profiles — maybe adjust calibration to preserve clarifying tokens. I'll add a short eval comparing v8b vs v8b-quant on a set of our prompt categories.

Elena (Support): ACME — can you confirm if you want us to pin for your tenant until we release a config guard? If yes, we can enable it and follow up when resolved.

ACME Support: Yes please pin for now. Appreciate the fast help. :thumbsup:

Kai (ML Eng): Noted. Will follow up with postmortem and recommended routing/quantization changes.
